system.description: Forethought, readiness, and the habit of anticipating what might be needed before the need arises. Preparedness is the counterpart to Scrounge: where Scrounge finds things in the moment, Preparedness reflects having already put them there. It covers pre-planned equipment caches, contingency thinking, established procedures for likely emergencies, and the capacity to produce a solution that you had the foresight to prepare. It is also the skill of planning ahead - routes scouted, exits noted, resources mapped.
system.overcome: Use Preparedness to produce an item, piece of information, or resource that your character could plausibly have prepared or positioned in advance, without requiring an in-scene search. The roll establishes whether your planning was adequate, not whether the item exists.
system.caa: Use Preparedness to establish prior planning as a scene aspect - Already Scouted the Route, Supply Cache at the Rendezvous, Backup Key Hidden Before We Left, Signal Agreed in Advance - that your group can invoke during the current situation.
system.attack: Preparedness gives the the best resources to fight with, but can't make the Attack itself.
system.defend: If you're walking into a gun fight and you've prepared by fitting your shirt with an iron plate, then you can have a single Defend action from Preparedness.
